task.description:
Validate OIDC-10 for release.

1. Read the test report at tests/reports/report-WF02-oidc10-20260527-step04.json
2. Run full build: zig build (must exit 0)
3. Run unit tests: zig build test (must exit 0)
4. Run integration tests: zig build test-integration-oidc10 (must exit 0)
5. Run benchmarks: zig build bench (verify NFR results pass)
6. Verify all OIDC-10 MUST acceptance criteria are covered and passing
7. Write release decision to docs/status/release-OIDC-10-20260527.json
8. Commit and push to feature/WF02-oidc10-20260527
